property_summary: For any caller and any block/state where the fallback is called with exactly 10 ether and a strictly greater timestamp than pastBlockTime, the reference contract empties its balance iff block.number % 15 == 0; the mutant inverts that condition (empties when block.number % 15 != 0) and thus violates this rule for some block numbers.
change_summary: Change the conditional so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0, altering when balance is emptied and thus observed state.
